packageRules.description: TypeScript 7.0 ships no compiler API. typescript-eslint, svelte-check, and knip need it, and no build step runs tsc. TypeScript 7.1 is expected to restore the API, so Renovate may propose 7.1 and later. Remove this rule when that update lands (https://github.com/typescript-eslint/typescript-eslint/issues/10940).
deck.gl and luma.gl release as one rendering suite. pnpm-workspace.yaml pins luma.gl because deck.gl 9.3 accepts luma.gl 9.4, which fails its shader assertions, so both must move in one update.
